description: Queue a report, native PowerPoint or saved Highlights video in an organization Hub session. Reuses saved reports and findings; no need to run exhaustive analysis first. Highlights follow default-report learning goals/quotes, with original audio when available and no artificial narration for chat studies; prompt does not select different quotes. Poll inspect_research_session view=job until succeeded; then read its output_id. Retry with the same key.

organization_id.description: Platform admins only: select an organization for this operation. Required when changing another organization’s study or using its wallet.
